description: MANAGEMENT data class. Read one versioned budget: identity-free header, its pinned P&L tree, and filtered/paginated cells with entered-versus-inferred truth. Amounts and locked FX rate are decimal strings. Filter months, lines, centres, or inference before paging; the signed page_token is source-pinned, so restart at page 1 if source_changed. Cells across different P&L lines are not one meaningful grand total, so no cross-line grand total is exposed. No people, ownership, editability, or approval identities are returned.

page_token.description: Signed continuation from the prior page; restart without it if source_changed.

name: get_budget
title: Read budget
